regime_context: The detector shows Canada/TSX in a broad, two-speed rotation: Oil & Gas Producers is the clear momentum leader (score 1.61, high breadth 0.79, but crowded and only mixed Hurst), while a precious-metals complex (Gold Miners, Base Metals, Silver) sits as the challenger block with lower durability. The validated edge is drawdown control only; cross-sectional rank has no forward return edge, and the 99-call track record shows solid hit rate but weak directional accuracy (0.34), so conviction must be modest.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Base Metals & Copper can convert its rank-3 momentum into a durability handoff: currently mean-revert Hurst and near-zero breadth (0.111) mean leadership is not confirmed. I would retire this watch only if breadh rises above ~0.5 AND durability_bar climbs above ~0.5 on consecutive scans.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is the strongest challenger to the oil leader with a momentum score of 1.11, but durability is only 0.48 and breadth is thin at 0.267 — leadership is narrow. The trend gate holds (eligible=true), so the absolute-trend discipline would keep it in an allocation rather than cut it, but the mixed Hurst and low breadth argue against treating this as a durable regime.
evidence: durability_bar 0.48 — moderate but below the 0.68 of the leader
breadth 0.267 — narrow participation, not confirmed broad leadership
theses.dissent: Thin breadth means the theme is carried by few names; a single sharp reversal in gold spot or a hawkish rate surprise could unwind the entire complex quickly, and Hurst 'mixed' signals the trend is not persistent.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO loses more than 7% while XEG.TO gains before the check-by date

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas Producers is the dominant narrative with high momentum (1.61) and the highest durability (0.68) paired with strong breadth (0.786), so leadership is genuinely broad rather than a one-name artifact. However the theme is crowded (crowding_z 1.04, crowded=true) and Hurst is mixed, so this is a cap/down-size caution, not a chase — the discipline says stay with the trend but do not add.
evidence: breadth 0.786 — broad participation confirms cohesive leadership
crowding_z 1.04, crowded=true — size-down caution only, not a fade
theses.dissent: The crowding flag plus mixed Hurst means the trend may be late-stage; energy is the most reflexive sector and a sharp crude reversal or an unscheduled macro surprise (macro backdrop is 100% unscheduled news) could hit it hard even with good breadth.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO breaks below its 20-day average while gold miners XGD.TO make a three-day consecutive relative high vs Oil & Gas before the check-by date
